definition_quote.value: Registered nursing includes: diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems; assisting individuals and groups to maintain or attain optimal health; assessing health status; establishing a nursing diagnosis; establishing goals; prescribing nursing interventions; delegating nursing interventions; providing for safe and effective nursing care; evaluating responses to interventions; teaching; managing and supervising nursing practice; consulting and coordinating with other health care professionals; and performing additional acts prescribed by the board.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing" includes the following: (a) Diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems. (b) Assisting individuals and groups to maintain or attain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment. (c) Assessing the health status of individuals and groups. (d) Establishing a nursing diagnosis.
